Harmonizing the approach to deriving nutrient requirements


Among low- and middle-income countries in particular, NRVs are key to formulating food and nutrition policy; developing food
assistance programs, nutrition education, and monitoring population health. A number of actions can be taken in support of
harmonizing the approaches to deriving NRVs. A future global dialog to gather support for harmonization as well as to identify
a pathway for implementing the actions identiﬁed in the three NASEM reports will move the process forward. A collective effort
among these groups is needed to describe the harmonization approach, as well as advocate for its implementation.
